revisions.goal: Fix the artifact log view and make every artifact card open its modal reliably.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: The artifact log view renders and responds correctly for the supported artifact states; clicking any artifact card opens the corresponding artifact modal; existing artifact interactions remain intact; relevant tests and checks pass.

milestones.title: Trace and reproduce
milestones.goal: Identify the failing log-view and card-click paths and establish a red-capable regression check.

milestones.title: Implement fix
milestones.goal: Correct the shared artifact interaction and log-view behavior with minimal scoped changes.

milestones.title: Verify and record
milestones.goal: Run relevant verification, commit implementation, and record the product evolution in EVE.
